caption: Figure 2: System configuration overview The activity Configure System takes engineering decisions at system level. These decisions are based on the System Configuration Input and the Collection of Available SWC Implementations. The AUTOSAR System Configuration Tool supports the decisions. Output of this activity is a complete System Configuration Description and an associated System Communication-Matrix.
